description: Hand labels for the ARKEXA prevalence corpus: every workflow the collection queries returned, kept whatever it turned out to contain. Supports one claim - the share of agentic workflows an outsider can reach. Never enriched, never used for precision or recall. See ../../METHODOLOGY.md.
claim: Of agentic workflows, what share contain at least one externally reachable path from attacker-controlled text to a privileged agent action? Reported as a proportion with a Wilson 95% confidence interval and the judgeable n, never as a bare percentage.

fields.id: corpus id; the file, repository and commit it maps to are private
fields.triggers: the events declared in the workflow
fields.label: vulnerable | clean
fields.expected_rules: rule ids a correct scanner should report, empty for clean
fields.rationale: the exploit path for vulnerable, the reason it is safe for clean
